title: ELISA LIVE — master regia
notes: NEW PERFORMANCE DIRECTION: preserve the believable desktop/social-feed dramaturgy, then progressively turn vertical scrolling into the physical current of a 3D image cyclone. The cyclone target is approximately minute 12 and remains a rehearsal target, not an automated cue.
Backup/master score for the new live performance. Macro cues remain manual.
Dialogue cue times are relative to scene start.
Imported legacy scene starts are preserved as reference; they are not yet authoritative for the new live score.
The uploaded dialogues file and uploaded performance JSON disagree in some section labels/timing comments; no silent reconciliation has been applied.

developmentDirection.target: feed → unstable interface → detached image planes → navigable XYZ field → scroll-driven vertical cyclone
developmentDirection.principle: The transition must feel continuous: the feed itself becomes space; do not cut from a webpage to a separate visual scene.
developmentDirection.timingPolicy: rehearsal target only; operator triggers modes manually

interaction.verticalScroll: In 2D it scrolls the feed. As spatialization grows it progressively becomes current velocity/direction; in cyclone mode it circulates the planes through a looping vertical helix.
interaction.audio: modulates movement intensity, scale, depth and turbulence; it does not choose macro cues

spatialRules: Posts remain image planes; no planar XY rotation vocabulary for the feed breakup.
No static scrolling feed should remain underneath once breakup/spatial modes begin.
Planes circulate continuously: exiting below/behind must recycle into the current rather than disappear.
Depth must be legible: near planes can become large and fast; distant planes small and slower.
Scroll direction reverses the current; wheel speed adds momentum; inertia decays after input stops.

feedArc.description: Believable social feed. Vertical scroll is still literal page navigation; repetition slowly becomes perceptible.
Images begin breathing/pulsing with audio while preserving grid identity.
Planes push outward from their cells through scale/depth accents. Grid is still readable.
The page loses structural authority. Image planes translate independently; no untouched feed layer remains below.
The whole archive acquires Z depth. The same feed becomes a navigable field rather than switching scene.
Target transformation. Real 3D image planes form a vertical helical current. Wheel input morphs from scroll into current velocity.
Operator plays the current: forward/reverse wheel, inertia, camera X/Y/Z and zoom. Audio perturbs radius, depth and turbulence.
Current tightens, fragments and can collapse toward the portal. Timing intentionally left open.

renderer.transition: At H, clone/map the currently visible archive media into textured Three.js planes and fade the DOM grid without a perceptual cut.

cyclone.geometry: vertical helix / cylindrical current with randomized radius, phase and Z/depth offsets
cyclone.recycling: loop plane positions through the helix so the archive can circulate indefinitely
